title: Finite oracle Turing machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet, a finite oracle Turing machine consists of a nonnegative number $k$ of ordinary work tapes, a finite state set with decidable equality, and an oracle Turing machine with those parameters whose query state and two answer states are pairwise distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number of ordinary work tapes
Decidable equality on the state set
Pairwise distinct query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states
